title: What It Actually Looks Like to Rest Without It Becoming Escape
caption:
A godly man rests. He doesn't disappear.

Scrolling for three hours isn't rest. It's the same noise, just lying down. If you feel more tired after than before, it was never rest. It was avoidance wearing rest's clothes.

Real rest costs you something: the phone in another room, a Sunday with nothing to prove. God rested on the seventh day not because He was tired, but because He was teaching the rhythm before you'd need it. Exodus 20:8 doesn't read like a suggestion for a hurried man.

Stop mid-task on purpose this week. Notice that nothing collapses. Rest isn't quitting on the work. It's trusting the One who never stops for it.
